newsitem.title: USA: Teradyne gets $4 mln order from Slovakia.
newsitem.headline: Teradyne gets $4 mln order from Slovakia.

text.p: Teradyne Inc said Wednesday it received an order valued at more than $4 million from Slovakia's Slovak Telecom to install an access network maintenance system.
The order is part of an agreement to provide equipment to Slovak Telecom with a unit of Alcatel Alsthom Cie Generale d'Electricite', a spokesman for Teradyne said.
Under the order, Teradyne will install its 4TEL Access Network Maintenance System throughout Slovak Telecom's network.

"4TEL will allow us to centralize our repair operations and respond to situations quickly in order to improve the time it takes to clear line faults in the network," Jaromir Trencina, Slovak Telecom network maintenance manager, said in a statement provided by Teradyne.
